prompt: Create exactly 400 app icons in exactly 20 columns and 20 rows, matching the schematic's continuous square lattice. Each cell occupies exactly 1/20 of the canvas width and 1/20 of its height. Fill EVERY square completely, including the bottom-right cell. The icon background must reach all four edges and all four corners of its square. Use sharp 90-degree corners: NO rounded tiles, rounded clipping, corner cutouts, transparent corners, whitespace, gutters, outer margins, or blank cells. Adjacent square backgrounds touch. Keep each symbol inside its own square. Every 2 by 2 block is one family: Light at top-left, Dark at top-right, Active at bottom-left, Disabled at bottom-right. Repeat the same symbol in all four cells of each family. Light has a pale background; Dark has a dark background; Active has an accent-colored background; Disabled has a subdued gray background. Preserve the family order supplied below. The checkerboards and lattice lines are guide marks only: replace them completely with artwork. No captions, guide lines, checkerboards, exterior shadows, or extra rows or columns. Use crisp symbols and subtle internal depth; any rounded shape in a style reference must not change the square cell backgrounds.
